title: Provo, UT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Provo, UT: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Provo is a city in UT with a population of 117,000. Home of Brigham Young University with Silicon Slopes tech growth and mountain access. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.7.
